description: This PHP source file generates a web page interface for displaying and managing Voice Quality Metrics for telephony lines. It includes logic for handling user input, dynamic content rendering, and data presentation related to voice call metrics like jitter, MOS scores, delay, and power levels.

methods.name: jProgress
methods.description: Displays a progress indicator during AJAX operations.

methods.name: jAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with a message.

methods.name: jHide
methods.description: Hides any active progress or alert dialogs.
